newsitem.title: USA: AMNEX names Alan Rossi CEO, chairman.
newsitem.headline: AMNEX names Alan Rossi CEO, chairman.

text.p: AMNEX Inc said on Thursday it appointed Alan Rossi as chief executive officer and chairman of the board of directors.
AMNEX said Rossi will replace Kenneth Baritz, who resigned to pursue other interests.
It also said it had named Peter Izzo as president.
Izzo, formerly president and chief executive officer of AMNEX, was working as president of the PubCom division, it added.
AMNEX provides telecommunications products and services like direct dial and operator-assisted long distance calling.
